name: Jack-in-Irons

attributes.attribute: a British folkloric figure heard clanking chains and seen looming at night in Yorkshire

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Jack-in-Irons is a British folkloric figure. Travelers in the northern English region of Yorkshire heard the sound of clanking chains at night. They saw a strange looming figure. The figure said nothing, threatening or otherwise. His silent presence was still said to be frightening.
objective: Document Jack-in-Irons as a silent, frightening British folkloric figure.
key_results: Record his appearance in Yorkshire at night.
Record the sound of clanking chains.
Note that he never spoke but still frightened travelers.
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): Jack-in-Irons entry.
